capabilities: Play photos, GIFs and videos as a slideshow with modes like Shuffle, Favorites Only and On This Day
Manage vault media through a gallery grid with favorites, hide, rename and delete actions
Configure appearance with presets, 25+ transitions and playback timing
Build playlists and profiles combining sources, modes and presets
Import media via drag-and-drop into a dedicated vault folder
extras: Not yet published in the official Obsidian community plugin directory; must be installed manually from GitHub. README states it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation such as website, changelog and security notes are linked separately.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display vault media as an ambient slideshow or photo frame; images and videos just sit as files.
summary: Ambient media player that turns folders of photos, GIFs and videos into a digital photo frame, fullscreen gallery and slideshow inside Obsidian.
